new_value: Audit complete (design note for uwip.2/gygz and uwip.3/dzyt; no code change - review passes vacuous for an audit deliverable). FINDINGS: (1) lr1110 is the only driver with CAD: lr1110_cad_impl (lr1110.c:942-1010) DISABLES DIO9 and polls system_get_status every 10ms for CADDONE|CADDETECTED (masks already exist and are the natural IRQ path), classifies busy=CADDETECTED, fail-closed on timeout (-ETIMEDOUT, busy=true), exits to standby; wrapper at :1025-1034 takes modem_acquire so it returns -EBUSY while async RX is armed. (2) lora_sim/lora_renode/lora_loopback have NO cad API at all - lichen_lora_cad_run returns -ENOTSUP for them, so CSMA TX is suppressed (or must be disabled) on those drivers when cca_enabled. (3) struct lora_driver_api is upstream Zephyr (pinned v4.1.0 zephyr/ is out-of-repo) - the async CAD entry point must be a LICHEN-level extension: reuse/extend the existing cad_registry entry (lora_l2_tx.c:30, LICHEN_LORA_CAD_REGISTRY_SIZE slots mapping dev->blocking callback) with lichen_lora_cad_start(dev, timeout, done_cb, user_data) and a done callback of the lichen_csma_cad_fn-compatible shape. (4) csma.c is ALREADY two-phase - lichen_csma_cad_begin (:125) / lichen_csma_cad_complete (:147, takes cad_status + channel_busy, returns backoff/result) - so the CSMA engine is continuation-ready; the only blocking element is lichen_lora_cad_run (:68-94) plus csma_cad's synchronous call into it. HAZARDS for the implementers: lr1110 CAD must keep failing -EBUSY while async RX holds the modem (interplay with the RX re-arm loop), preserve the fail-closed timeout classification in the async path, and DIO9 re-enable must not race the armed async RX (mutually exclusive by modem_acquire already). No strnlen-class env hazards in scope.
